81	    PATH: "{{ ansible_facts['env']['HOME'] }}/.cargo/bin:{{ ansible_facts['env']['HOME'] }}/.local/bin:{{ ansible_facts['env']['PATH'] }}"
82	
83	- name: Install Alacritty via cargo
84	  when:
85	    - ansible_facts['os_family'] == 'Debian'
86	    - target_architecture != 'armv7l'

91	  environment:

93	  timeout: 3600
94	
95	- name: Ensure user icon + application dirs exist
96	  when:
97	    - ansible_facts['os_family'] == 'Debian'
98	    - target_architecture != 'armv7l'
99	  ansible.builtin.file:
100	    path: "{{ ansible_facts['env']['HOME'] }}/{{ item }}"
101	    state: directory
102	    mode: '0755'
103	  loop:
104	    - .local/share/icons/hicolor/scalable/apps
105	    - .local/share/applications

133	      Name=Alacritty

140	    - ansible_facts['os_family'] == 'Debian'
141	    - target_architecture != 'armv7l'

143	  changed_when: false

146	# =============================================================================
147	# libfuse2 — AppImage runtime on Ubuntu 22.04+
148	# Ubuntu dropped libfuse2 from the default install around 22.04; AppImages
149	# compiled against it fail with a cryptic "dlopen(): error loading libfuse.so.2"
150	# on boot. Installing the compat package fixes every AppImage we ship below.
151	# =============================================================================
152	
153	- name: Install libfuse2 for AppImage compatibility
154	  when:
155	    - ansible_facts['os_family'] == 'Debian'
156	    - target_architecture != 'armv7l'
157	  become: true
158	  tags: [sudo]
159	  ansible.builtin.apt:
160	    name: libfuse2
161	    state: present
162	    update_cache: false
163	  ignore_errors: true
164	
165	# =============================================================================
166	# AppImageLauncher — desktop integration for AppImages
167	#
168	# Strategy (in order):
169	#   1. PPA `ppa:appimagelauncher-team/stable` — preferred on 20.04/22.04.
170	#   2. GitHub `.deb` fallback — PPA is known-broken on Ubuntu 24.04 "noble"
171	#      as of 2026 (upstream has not published a noble release); the latest
172	#      GitHub `.deb` still installs cleanly.
173	#   3. AppImageLauncher **Lite** — a user-level AppImage that integrates
174	#      itself without root. Enabled when `gui_apps_linux_no_root=true`.
175	#
176	# Docs: see docs/tools/appimage.md for install paths, ail-cli usage, and
177	# the libfuse2 / AppArmor gotchas on recent Ubuntu.
178	# =============================================================================
179	
180	- name: Check if AppImageLauncher is installed (system-wide)
181	  when:
182	    - ansible_facts['os_family'] == 'Debian'
183	    - target_architecture != 'armv7l'
184	  ansible.builtin.command: dpkg -s appimagelauncher
185	  register: ail_check
186	  changed_when: false
187	  failed_when: false
188	
189	- name: Install AppImageLauncher via PPA
190	  when:
191	    - ansible_facts['os_family'] == 'Debian'
192	    - target_architecture != 'armv7l'
193	    - not (gui_apps_linux_no_root | bool)
194	    - ail_check.rc != 0
195	  become: true
196	  tags: [sudo]
197	  block:
198	    # deb822_repository (apt_repository is deprecated, removed in ansible-core
199	    # 2.25) doesn't support the ppa: shorthand — spell out the launchpad URI +
200	    # signing key. Fingerprint from
201	    # https://api.launchpad.net/devel/~appimagelauncher-team/+archive/ubuntu/stable
202	    # It also doesn't run `apt update` itself, so verify reachability and roll
203	    # the .sources file back on failure — a leftover broken source would fail
204	    # the base role's cache update on every later run.
205	    # Requires python3-debian (installed by the base role).
206	    - name: Remove legacy one-line AppImageLauncher PPA source (pre-deb822 format)
207	      ansible.builtin.file:
208	        path: /etc/apt/sources.list.d/appimagelauncher-team-stable.list
209	        state: absent
210	
211	    - name: Add AppImageLauncher PPA (deb822)
212	      ansible.builtin.deb822_repository:
213	        name: appimagelauncher-team-stable
214	        types: deb
215	        uris: https://ppa.launchpadcontent.net/appimagelauncher-team/stable/ubuntu
216	        suites: "{{ ansible_facts['distribution_release'] }}"
217	        components: main
218	        signed_by: https://keyserver.ubuntu.com/pks/lookup?op=get&search=0xACD802F535B6F55D365285574AF9B16F75EF2FCA
219	      ignore_errors: true
220	      register: ail_ppa
221	
222	    - name: Refresh apt cache (AppImageLauncher PPA)
223	      when: ail_ppa is succeeded
224	      ansible.builtin.apt:
225	        update_cache: true
226	      ignore_errors: true
227	
228	    # The apt module treats a partially-failed `apt update` (one unreachable
229	    # source, others fine) as SUCCESS-with-warnings, so probe the PPA
230	    # deterministically: package resolvable from the launchpad URI ⇒ keep +
231	    # install; otherwise roll the .sources file back (a leftover broken
232	    # source breaks/slows every later apt update) and let the GitHub .deb
233	    # fallback below take over.
234	    - name: Check appimagelauncher is resolvable from the PPA
235	      when: ail_ppa is succeeded
236	      ansible.builtin.command: apt-cache policy appimagelauncher
237	      register: ail_policy
238	      changed_when: false
239	      failed_when: false
240	
241	    - name: Remove AppImageLauncher PPA (broken or unreachable)
242	      when:
243	        - ail_ppa is succeeded
244	        - "'ppa.launchpadcontent.net/appimagelauncher-team' not in (ail_policy.stdout | default(''))"
245	      ansible.builtin.deb822_repository:
246	        name: appimagelauncher-team-stable
247	        state: absent
248	
249	    - name: Install appimagelauncher from PPA
250	      ansible.builtin.apt:
251	        name: appimagelauncher
252	        state: present
253	      when: "'ppa.launchpadcontent.net/appimagelauncher-team' in (ail_policy.stdout | default(''))"
254	      register: ail_apt_install
255	      ignore_errors: true
256	  rescue:
257	    - name: Warn AppImageLauncher PPA install failed
258	      ansible.builtin.debug:
259	        msg: "AppImageLauncher PPA install failed — trying GitHub .deb fallback next."
260	
261	- name: Install AppImageLauncher from GitHub .deb (fallback)
262	  when:
263	    - ansible_facts['os_family'] == 'Debian'
264	    - target_architecture in ['x86_64', 'aarch64']
265	    - not (gui_apps_linux_no_root | bool)
266	    - ail_check.rc != 0
267	    - (ail_apt_install is not defined) or (ail_apt_install is not succeeded)
268	  become: true
269	  tags: [sudo]
270	  block:
271	    - name: Get latest AppImageLauncher release metadata
272	      ansible.builtin.uri:
273	        url: https://api.github.com/repos/TheAssassin/AppImageLauncher/releases/latest
274	        return_content: true
275	      register: ail_release
276	
277	    - name: Resolve AppImageLauncher .deb asset URL
278	      ansible.builtin.set_fact:
279	        ail_deb_url: >-
280	          {{ (ail_release.json.assets
281	              | selectattr('name', 'match', '^appimagelauncher_.*_' + ail_deb_arch + '\\.deb$')
282	              | map(attribute='browser_download_url')
283	              | list
284	              | first) | default('') }}
285	      vars:
286	        ail_deb_arch: "{{ {'x86_64': 'amd64', 'aarch64': 'arm64'}[target_architecture] }}"
287	
288	    - name: Download AppImageLauncher .deb
289	      when: ail_deb_url | length > 0
290	      ansible.builtin.get_url:
291	        url: "{{ ail_deb_url }}"
292	        dest: /tmp/appimagelauncher.deb
293	        mode: '0644'
294	        timeout: 180
295	
296	    - name: Install AppImageLauncher .deb
297	      when: ail_deb_url | length > 0
298	      ansible.builtin.apt:
299	        deb: /tmp/appimagelauncher.deb
300	        state: present
301	  rescue:
302	    - name: Warn AppImageLauncher .deb install failed
303	      ansible.builtin.debug:
304	        msg: "AppImageLauncher .deb install failed — the Lite user-level variant is still available via noRoot mode."
305	
306	- name: Install AppImageLauncher Lite (user-level, noRoot)
307	  when:
308	    - ansible_facts['os_family'] == 'Debian'
309	    - target_architecture in ['x86_64', 'aarch64']
310	    - gui_apps_linux_no_root | bool
311	  block:
312	    - name: Ensure ~/Applications exists
313	      ansible.builtin.file:
314	        path: "{{ ansible_facts['env']['HOME'] }}/Applications"
315	        state: directory
316	        mode: '0755'
317	
318	    - name: Get latest AppImageLauncher release (for Lite variant)
319	      ansible.builtin.uri:
320	        url: https://api.github.com/repos/TheAssassin/AppImageLauncher/releases/latest
321	        return_content: true
322	      register: ail_lite_release
323	
324	    - name: Resolve AppImageLauncher Lite AppImage URL
325	      ansible.builtin.set_fact:
326	        ail_lite_url: >-
327	          {{ (ail_lite_release.json.assets
328	              | selectattr('name', 'match', '^appimagelauncher-lite-.*-' + target_architecture + '\\.AppImage$')
329	              | map(attribute='browser_download_url')
330	              | list
331	              | first) | default('') }}
332	
333	    - name: Download AppImageLauncher Lite
334	      when: ail_lite_url | length > 0
335	      ansible.builtin.get_url:
336	        url: "{{ ail_lite_url }}"
337	        dest: "{{ ansible_facts['env']['HOME'] }}/Applications/appimagelauncher-lite.AppImage"
338	        mode: '0755'
339	        timeout: 180
340	      register: ail_lite_dl
341	      ignore_errors: true
342	
343	    - name: Note how to finalise AppImageLauncher Lite integration
344	      when: ail_lite_dl is defined and ail_lite_dl is succeeded
345	      ansible.builtin.debug:
346	        msg: >-
347	          Downloaded AppImageLauncher Lite to ~/Applications/appimagelauncher-lite.AppImage.
348	          Run `~/Applications/appimagelauncher-lite.AppImage install` once to register
349	          the integration; see docs/tools/appimage.md for ail-cli usage.
350	
351	# =============================================================================
352	# Visual Studio Code — official Microsoft apt repository
353	# =============================================================================
354	
355	- name: Check if VSCode is installed
356	  when:
357	    - ansible_facts['os_family'] == 'Debian'
358	    - target_architecture != 'armv7l'
359	  ansible.builtin.command: dpkg -s code
360	  register: vscode_check
361	  changed_when: false
362	  failed_when: false
363	
364	- name: Install VSCode via Microsoft apt repo
365	  when:
366	    - ansible_facts['os_family'] == 'Debian'
367	    - target_architecture in ['x86_64', 'aarch64']
368	    - not (gui_apps_linux_no_root | bool)
369	    - vscode_check.rc != 0
370	  become: true
371	  tags: [sudo]
372	  block:
373	    - name: Ensure /etc/apt/keyrings exists
374	      ansible.builtin.file:
375	        path: /etc/apt/keyrings
376	        state: directory
377	        mode: '0755'
378	
379	    - name: Add Microsoft GPG key (dearmored)
380	      ansible.builtin.shell: |
381	        set -eu
382	        wget -qO- https://packages.microsoft.com/keys/microsoft.asc \
383	          | gpg --dearmor -o /etc/apt/keyrings/microsoft.gpg
384	      args:
385	        creates: /etc/apt/keyrings/microsoft.gpg
386	
387	    # apt_repository is deprecated (removed in ansible-core 2.25); deb822
388	    # doesn't run `apt update` itself, so refresh explicitly. A cache-update
389	    # failure lands in the rescue below, which rolls the .sources file back
390	    # so it can't break the base role's cache update on later runs.
391	    # Requires python3-debian (installed by the base role).
392	    - name: Remove legacy one-line VSCode source (pre-deb822 format)
393	      ansible.builtin.file:
394	        path: /etc/apt/sources.list.d/vscode.list
395	        state: absent
396	
397	    - name: Add VSCode apt repository (deb822)
398	      ansible.builtin.deb822_repository:
399	        name: vscode
400	        types: deb
401	        uris: https://packages.microsoft.com/repos/code
402	        suites: stable
403	        components: main
404	        architectures: "{{ {'x86_64': 'amd64', 'aarch64': 'arm64'}[target_architecture] }}"
405	        signed_by: /etc/apt/keyrings/microsoft.gpg
406	
407	    - name: Refresh apt cache (VSCode repo)
408	      ansible.builtin.apt:
409	        update_cache: true
410	
411	    - name: Install VSCode package
412	      ansible.builtin.apt:
413	        name: code
414	        state: present
415	  rescue:
416	    - name: Remove VSCode apt repository (install failed; avoid leaving a broken source)
417	      ansible.builtin.deb822_repository:
418	        name: vscode
419	        state: absent
420	      ignore_errors: true
421	
422	    - name: Warn VSCode install failed
423	      ansible.builtin.debug:
424	        msg: "VSCode install failed — rerun with --tags gui_apps after fixing network/GPG/apt issues."
425	
426	# =============================================================================
427	# Cursor — .deb from cursor.com
428	#
429	# The download API returns a redirect to the latest build for the given
430	# platform. The whole block is tolerant: a failed download is logged but
431	# does not fail the playbook. Users can always fall back to the AppImage
432	# path documented in docs/tools/appimage.md.
433	# =============================================================================
434	
435	- name: Check if Cursor is installed
436	  when:
437	    - ansible_facts['os_family'] == 'Debian'
438	    - target_architecture != 'armv7l'
439	  ansible.builtin.command: dpkg -s cursor
440	  register: cursor_check
441	  changed_when: false
442	  failed_when: false
443	
444	- name: Install Cursor via .deb
445	  when:
446	    - ansible_facts['os_family'] == 'Debian'
447	    - target_architecture in ['x86_64', 'aarch64']
448	    - not (gui_apps_linux_no_root | bool)
449	    - cursor_check.rc != 0
450	  become: true
451	  tags: [sudo]
452	  block:
453	    # cursor.com/api/download returns JSON ({downloadUrl, debUrl, rpmUrl, ...}),
454	    # not a redirect to the binary. Must resolve debUrl first, then fetch.
455	    - name: Fetch latest Cursor release metadata
456	      ansible.builtin.uri:
457	        url: >-
458	          https://cursor.com/api/download?platform=linux-{{
459	            {'x86_64': 'x64', 'aarch64': 'arm64'}[target_architecture]
460	          }}&releaseTrack=stable
461	        return_content: true
462	      register: cursor_meta
463	      ignore_errors: true
464	
465	    # downloads.cursor.com routes poorly from GFW-region networks and TCP
466	    # streams frequently drop mid-transfer ("Incomplete read" with partial
467	    # st_size). get_url has no native resume, so retry the whole fetch up
468	    # to 4 times — 4 x 174MB is cheaper than babysitting a failed install.
469	    - name: Download latest Cursor .deb
470	      when:
471	        - cursor_meta is defined
472	        - cursor_meta is succeeded
473	        - cursor_meta.json is defined
474	        - cursor_meta.json.debUrl is defined
475	      ansible.builtin.get_url:
476	        url: "{{ cursor_meta.json.debUrl }}"
477	        dest: /tmp/cursor.deb
478	        mode: '0644'
479	        timeout: 300
480	        force: true
481	      register: cursor_dl
482	      until: cursor_dl is succeeded
483	      retries: 4
484	      delay: 5
485	      ignore_errors: true
486	
487	    - name: Install Cursor .deb
488	      when: cursor_dl is defined and cursor_dl is succeeded
489	      ansible.builtin.apt:
490	        deb: /tmp/cursor.deb
491	        state: present
492	      ignore_errors: true
493	  rescue:
494	    - name: Warn Cursor .deb install failed
495	      ansible.builtin.debug:
496	        msg: >-
497	          Cursor .deb install failed. You can fall back to the AppImage flow —
498	          download from https://cursor.com/download and drop it under
499	          ~/Applications/; AppImageLauncher will auto-integrate. See
500	          docs/tools/appimage.md for the full recipe.
501	
502	# =============================================================================
503	# Discord — channel selectable via discord_channel ansible var (default: flatpak)
504	#
505	# Values (set by .discordChannel chezmoi prompt, plumbed via
506	# .chezmoiscripts/global/run_onchange_after_20_ansible_roles.sh.tmpl):
507	#   - flatpak: Flathub com.discordapp.Discord; auto-updates via `flatpak update`.
508	#              The recommended path — Discord .deb does NOT ship an apt-source
509	#              postinst, so .deb installs require manual re-deploy on every
510	#              release (the in-app updater pops a download modal but cannot
511	#              actually run dpkg). Flatpak side-steps that pain.
512	#   - deb:     Fetch the official .deb; only re-fetches when dpkg -s discord
513	#              fails. Keep this path for users who already standardized on the
514	#              .deb and don't want a Flatpak runtime on disk.
515	#   - none:    Skip — install Discord some other way (Vesktop, web app, etc.).
516	#
517	# Discord upstream only ships amd64 binaries; both .deb and Flathub follow.
518	# armhf is not supported by either path. See
519	# docs/playbooks/linux-gui-apps.md for the full decision tree.
520	# =============================================================================
521	
522	- name: Set Discord channel default
523	  when: ansible_facts['os_family'] == 'Debian'
524	  ansible.builtin.set_fact:
525	    discord_channel: "{{ discord_channel | default('flatpak') }}"
526	
527	- name: Warn Discord is amd64-only on Linux (aarch64)
528	  when:
529	    - ansible_facts['os_family'] == 'Debian'
530	    - target_architecture == 'aarch64'
531	    - discord_channel != 'none'
532	  ansible.builtin.debug:
533	    msg: >-
534	      Discord does not publish official aarch64 binaries (no .deb, no
535	      Flatpak ARM build). Skipping. Use a community build like Vesktop on
536	      ARM64 if you need Discord — see https://github.com/Vencord/Vesktop.
537	
538	# --- deb channel ----------------------------------------------------------
539	
540	- name: Check if Discord .deb is installed
541	  when:
542	    - ansible_facts['os_family'] == 'Debian'
543	    - target_architecture == 'x86_64'
544	    - discord_channel == 'deb'
545	  ansible.builtin.command: dpkg -s discord
546	  register: discord_check
547	  changed_when: false
548	  failed_when: false
549	
550	- name: Install Discord via .deb
551	  when:
552	    - ansible_facts['os_family'] == 'Debian'
553	    - target_architecture == 'x86_64'
554	    - discord_channel == 'deb'
555	    - not (gui_apps_linux_no_root | bool)
556	    - discord_check.rc != 0
557	  become: true
558	  tags: [sudo]
559	  block:
560	    - name: Download latest Discord .deb (redirect from discord.com)
561	      ansible.builtin.get_url:
562	        url: https://discord.com/api/download?platform=linux&format=deb
563	        dest: /tmp/discord.deb
564	        mode: '0644'
565	        timeout: 300
566	      register: discord_dl
567	      ignore_errors: true
568	
569	    - name: Install Discord .deb
570	      when: discord_dl is defined and discord_dl is succeeded
571	      ansible.builtin.apt:
572	        deb: /tmp/discord.deb
573	        state: present
574	      ignore_errors: true
575	  rescue:
576	    - name: Warn Discord .deb install failed
577	      ansible.builtin.debug:
578	        msg: >-
579	          Discord .deb install failed. Fall back to the official tarball at
580	          https://discord.com/api/download?platform=linux&format=tar.gz
581	          (extract to ~/Applications/Discord/ and wire up a .desktop entry),
582	          or switch to Flatpak by setting discordChannel=flatpak in
583	          ~/.config/chezmoi/chezmoi.toml.
584	
585	# --- flatpak channel ------------------------------------------------------
586	
587	- name: Install Discord via Flatpak (channel=flatpak)
588	  when:
589	    - ansible_facts['os_family'] == 'Debian'
590	    - target_architecture == 'x86_64'
591	    - discord_channel == 'flatpak'
592	    - not (gui_apps_linux_no_root | bool)
593	  block:
594	    - name: Ensure flatpak package is present
595	      become: true
596	      tags: [sudo]
597	      ansible.builtin.apt:
598	        name: flatpak
599	        state: present
600	        update_cache: true
601	        cache_valid_time: 3600
602	
603	    - name: Ensure Flathub remote is configured (per-user)
604	      community.general.flatpak_remote:
605	        name: flathub
606	        flatpakrepo_url: https://flathub.org/repo/flathub.flatpakrepo
607	        method: user
608	        state: present
609	
610	    - name: Install Discord from Flathub (per-user)
611	      community.general.flatpak:
612	        name: com.discordapp.Discord
613	        state: present
614	        method: user
615	        remote: flathub
616	  rescue:
617	    - name: Warn Discord Flatpak install failed
618	      ansible.builtin.debug:
619	        msg: >-
620	          Discord Flatpak install failed. Manual fallback —
621	          `flatpak install flathub com.discordapp.Discord` from a shell,
622	          or set discordChannel=deb in ~/.config/chezmoi/chezmoi.toml to
623	          revert to the .deb path.
624	
625	# =============================================================================
626	# Steam — optional gaming bundle via Valve's official apt repository
627	#
628	# Gated by the `installGamingApps` chezmoi prompt, plumbed through
629	# `gui_apps_linux_install_gaming_apps`. Valve's repo publishes an amd64
630	# `steam-launcher` package and an i386 transitional package; adding i386 is
631	# required so Steam can resolve its 32-bit runtime libraries. Avoid hard-coding
632	# old package names like `libgl1-mesa-glx`, which no longer exists on Ubuntu
633	# 24.04 — let apt resolve current dependencies/recommends from the package.
634	# =============================================================================
635	
636	- name: Skip Steam on non-x86_64 Linux
637	  when:
638	    - ansible_facts['os_family'] == 'Debian'
639	    - gui_apps_linux_install_gaming_apps | bool
640	    - target_architecture != 'x86_64'
641	  ansible.builtin.debug:
642	    msg: >-
643	      Steam is only installed on x86_64 here. Valve's Ubuntu launcher and
644	      game runtime expect amd64/i386 packages; skipping on {{ target_architecture }}.
645	
646	- name: Skip Steam in noRoot mode
647	  when:
648	    - ansible_facts['os_family'] == 'Debian'
649	    - gui_apps_linux_install_gaming_apps | bool
650	    - target_architecture == 'x86_64'
651	    - gui_apps_linux_no_root | bool
652	  ansible.builtin.debug:
653	    msg: >-
654	      installGamingApps=true, but Steam requires sudo to add Valve's apt repo,
655	      enable i386, and install steam-launcher. Skipping in noRoot mode.
656	
657	- name: Install Steam via Valve apt repo
658	  when:
659	    - ansible_facts['os_family'] == 'Debian'
660	    - gui_apps_linux_install_gaming_apps | bool
661	    - target_architecture == 'x86_64'
662	    - not (gui_apps_linux_no_root | bool)
663	  block:
664	    - name: Check enabled foreign architectures (Steam)
665	      ansible.builtin.command: dpkg --print-foreign-architectures
666	      register: steam_foreign_arches
667	      changed_when: false
668	      failed_when: false
669	
670	    - name: Enable i386 architecture for Steam runtime
671	      when: "'i386' not in (steam_foreign_arches.stdout_lines | default([]))"
672	      become: true
673	      tags: [sudo]
674	      ansible.builtin.command: dpkg --add-architecture i386
675	
676	    - name: Ensure /usr/share/keyrings exists (Steam)
677	      become: true
678	      tags: [sudo]
679	      ansible.builtin.file:
680	        path: /usr/share/keyrings
681	        state: directory
682	        mode: '0755'
683	
684	    - name: Install Valve Steam apt signing key
685	      become: true
686	      tags: [sudo]
687	      ansible.builtin.get_url:
688	        url: https://repo.steampowered.com/steam/archive/stable/steam.gpg
689	        dest: /usr/share/keyrings/steam.gpg
690	        mode: '0644'
691	        force: true
692	        timeout: 120
693	
694	    - name: Remove legacy Steam apt source list files
695	      become: true
696	      tags: [sudo]
697	      ansible.builtin.file:
698	        path: "{{ item }}"
699	        state: absent
700	      loop:
701	        - /etc/apt/sources.list.d/steam.list
702	        - /etc/apt/sources.list.d/steam-stable.list
703	
704	    - name: Add Valve Steam apt repository
705	      become: true
706	      tags: [sudo]
707	      ansible.builtin.deb822_repository:
708	        name: steam
709	        types: deb
710	        uris: https://repo.steampowered.com/steam/
711	        suites: stable
712	        components: steam
713	        architectures:
714	          - amd64
715	          - i386
716	        signed_by: /usr/share/keyrings/steam.gpg
717	
718	    # Refresh ONLY the Steam source, not the whole apt config. A plain
719	    # `apt-get update` re-fetches every third-party source (vscode, cursor,
720	    # azure, hashicorp, ngrok, tailscale, …); on a flaky network/proxy any one
721	    # of them can make the update exit non-zero and (via the block rescue)
722	    # leave the just-added Valve repo unindexed → `steam-launcher` unresolvable.
723	    # Scoping to sources.list.d/steam.sources keeps this immune to sibling
724	    # sources. (No ansible.builtin.apt equivalent — it can't target one source.)
725	    # cache_valid_time is irrelevant here too: base already refreshed the cache
726	    # at play start, so an unscoped module call would skip and never index Steam.
727	    - name: Refresh apt cache for the Steam source only
728	      become: true
729	      tags: [sudo]
730	      ansible.builtin.command:
731	        cmd: >-
732	          apt-get update
733	          -o Dir::Etc::sourcelist=sources.list.d/steam.sources
734	          -o Dir::Etc::sourceparts=-
735	          -o APT::Get::List-Cleanup=0
736	      changed_when: false
737	
738	    - name: Install Steam launcher
739	      become: true
740	      tags: [sudo]
741	      ansible.builtin.apt:
742	        name: steam-launcher
743	        state: present
744	        install_recommends: true
745	        update_cache: false
746	  rescue:
747	    - name: Warn Steam install failed
748	      ansible.builtin.debug:
749	        msg: >-
750	          Steam install failed. Manual fallback: follow Valve's apt repo
751	          instructions at https://repo.steampowered.com/steam/ or install the
752	          latest launcher package from
753	          https://repo.steampowered.com/steam/archive/stable/steam_latest.deb.
754	
755	# =============================================================================
756	# Zen Browser — Firefox-based browser, shipped as an AppImage
757	#
758	# User-level install under ~/Applications/, mirrors the Alacritty pattern for
759	# desktop integration (icon + .desktop entry + update-desktop-database) so
760	# the app is searchable in GNOME/KDE launchers without needing to run the
761	# AppImage once to let AppImageLauncher auto-integrate it.
762	#
763	# noRoot-friendly: the whole block is user-level, no `become: true`, no
764	# `tags: [sudo]`. Works identically in `gui_apps_linux_no_root=true` mode.
765	# =============================================================================
766	
767	- name: Check if Zen AppImage is already installed
768	  when:
769	    - ansible_facts['os_family'] == 'Debian'
770	    - target_architecture in ['x86_64', 'aarch64']
771	  ansible.builtin.stat:
772	    path: "{{ ansible_facts['env']['HOME'] }}/Applications/zen.AppImage"
773	  register: zen_appimage_check
774	
775	- name: Install Zen Browser AppImage + desktop integration
776	  when:
777	    - ansible_facts['os_family'] == 'Debian'
778	    - target_architecture in ['x86_64', 'aarch64']
779	    - not zen_appimage_check.stat.exists
780	  block:
781	    - name: Ensure ~/Applications exists (Zen)
782	      ansible.builtin.file:
783	        path: "{{ ansible_facts['env']['HOME'] }}/Applications"
784	        state: directory
785	        mode: '0755'
786	
787	    - name: Get latest Zen Browser release metadata
788	      ansible.builtin.uri:
789	        url: https://api.github.com/repos/zen-browser/desktop/releases/latest
790	        return_content: true
791	      register: zen_release
792	
793	    - name: Resolve Zen AppImage asset URL
794	      ansible.builtin.set_fact:
795	        zen_appimage_url: >-
796	          {{ (zen_release.json.assets
797	              | selectattr('name', 'match', '^zen-' + target_architecture + '\\.AppImage$')
798	              | map(attribute='browser_download_url')
799	              | list
800	              | first) | default('') }}
801	
802	    - name: Download Zen AppImage
803	      when: zen_appimage_url | length > 0
804	      ansible.builtin.get_url:
805	        url: "{{ zen_appimage_url }}"
806	        dest: "{{ ansible_facts['env']['HOME'] }}/Applications/zen.AppImage"
807	        mode: '0755'
808	        timeout: 300
809	      retries: 3
810	      delay: 5
811	      register: zen_appimage_dl
812	
813	    - name: Download Zen SVG icon
814	      when: zen_appimage_dl is defined and zen_appimage_dl is succeeded
815	      ansible.builtin.get_url:
816	        url: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zen-browser/desktop/dev/docs/assets/zen-browser.svg
817	        dest: "{{ ansible_facts['env']['HOME'] }}/.local/share/icons/hicolor/scalable/apps/zen-browser.svg"
818	        mode: '0644'
819	      retries: 3
820	      delay: 5
821	      ignore_errors: true
822	
823	    - name: Install Zen Browser .desktop entry
824	      when: zen_appimage_dl is defined and zen_appimage_dl is succeeded
825	      ansible.builtin.copy:
826	        dest: "{{ ansible_facts['env']['HOME'] }}/.local/share/applications/zen-browser.desktop"
827	        mode: '0644'
828	        content: |
829	          [Desktop Entry]
830	          Type=Application
831	          Name=Zen Browser
832	          GenericName=Web Browser
833	          Comment=Experience tranquillity while browsing the web without people tracking you
834	          Exec={{ ansible_facts['env']['HOME'] }}/Applications/zen.AppImage %U
835	          TryExec={{ ansible_facts['env']['HOME'] }}/Applications/zen.AppImage
836	          Icon=zen-browser
837	          Terminal=false
838	          StartupNotify=true
839	          StartupWMClass=zen
840	          Categories=Network;WebBrowser;
841	          MimeType=text/html;text/xml;application/xhtml+xml;application/xml;application/rss+xml;application/rdf+xml;image/gif;image/jpeg;image/png;x-scheme-handler/http;x-scheme-handler/https;x-scheme-handler/ftp;x-scheme-handler/chrome;video/webm;application/x-xpinstall;
842	          Keywords=web;browser;internet;firefox;zen;
843	
844	    - name: Refresh desktop application database (Zen)
845	      when: zen_appimage_dl is defined and zen_appimage_dl is succeeded
846	      ansible.builtin.command: update-desktop-database "{{ ansible_facts['env']['HOME'] }}/.local/share/applications"
847	      changed_when: false
848	      failed_when: false
849	  rescue:
850	    - name: Warn Zen install failed
851	      ansible.builtin.debug:
852	        msg: >-
853	          Zen Browser install failed — you can fall back to downloading the
854	          AppImage manually from https://github.com/zen-browser/desktop/releases/latest
855	          into ~/Applications/ and re-running `update-desktop-database ~/.local/share/applications`.
856

871	# CopyQ — clipboard manager with scriptable CLI (`copyq read/select/eval/...`)
872	#
873	# Stock Ubuntu apt repos ship copyq on 22.04 (15.0 since 24.04, 4.x on 22.04),
874	# both new enough for the `cb`/`cbl`/`cbe` helper at
875	# dot_config/shell/56_clipboard_history.sh. No third-party PPA or .deb needed.
876	#
877	# Daemon autostart is shipped by the package as
878	# /etc/xdg/autostart/com.github.hluk.copyq.desktop — no systemd-user unit.
879	#
880	# macOS counterpart is Maccy (see Brewfile.darwin.tmpl); the helper detects
881	# whichever backend is installed at shell-startup time. Reason for the split:
882	# the CopyQ Homebrew cask is deprecated (disabled 2026-09-01) because
883	# CopyQ.app isn't signed for Gatekeeper — only the cask, not the project.
884	# =============================================================================

886	- name: Install CopyQ via apt (stock repos)
887	  when:

889	    - target_architecture != 'armv7l'

898	# App-control utilities — CLI tools used by `dot_config/shell/56_linux_apps.sh`
899	# (the app-* helpers: appquit / applaunch / appactivate / apprestart /
900	# apprunning / applist / appresponsive) and the `tv linux-apps` channel.

903	#   - playerctl  MPRIS CLI — appresponsive's only meaningful probe for media
904	#                players (Spotify, mpv, VLC, Firefox). The one cross-DE bright
905	#                spot for "is this app actually alive and answering."
906	#   - wmctrl     X11 window control. No-op on Wayland but cheap (~50KB) and
907	#                still useful if the user falls back to an X11 session.
908	#   - xdotool    X11 window + input control. Same Wayland caveat as wmctrl.
909	#

912	# in docs/playbooks/linux-gui-apps.md → "Controlling installed apps".
913	# =============================================================================

918	    - target_architecture != 'armv7l'
919	  become: true
920	  tags: [sudo, app_control]
921	  ansible.builtin.apt:
922	    name:
923	      - playerctl
924	      - wmctrl
925	      - xdotool
926	    state: present
927	    update_cache: false

9	# ignore the chezmoi-managed one. See docs/tools/container-config-map.md.

11	# ============================================
12	# macOS: OrbStack installation
13	# ============================================
14	
15	- name: Check if Docker Desktop is installed (macOS)
16	  when: ansible_facts["os_family"] == "Darwin"

18	    path: /Applications/Docker.app

27	    state: present

31	# ============================================

33	- name: Install rootless Docker prerequisites (Debian/Ubuntu)
34	  when: ansible_facts["os_family"] == "Debian"
35	  become: true
36	  tags: [sudo]
37	  ansible.builtin.apt:
38	    name:
39	      # user-namespace mapping (newuidmap / newgidmap)
40	      - uidmap
41	      # systemctl --user works over SSH / non-login shells
42	      - dbus-user-session
43	      # rootless overlay storage
44	      - fuse-overlayfs
45	      # rootless port publishing
46	      - slirp4netns
47	      # userland firewall (required by rootlesskit for port forwarding)
48	      - iptables
49	    state: present
50	    # Don't re-run apt-get update here: these are all main-archive packages
51	    # already covered by the base role's best-effort cache refresh at play
52	    # start. An inlined update_cache would let a single transient proxy/source
53	    # failure abort the whole play before later roles (e.g. gui_apps Steam)
54	    # ever run. See pitfalls/apt-update-fails-base-role-empty-error.md.
55	    update_cache: false
56	
57	- name: Check if Docker CLI is installed (Debian/Ubuntu)
58	  when: ansible_facts["os_family"] == "Debian"

60	  register: docker_check
61	  changed_when: false
62	  failed_when: false

65	  # Also pulls docker-ce-rootless-extras (provides dockerd-rootless-setuptool.sh).
66	  # We will disable the rootful unit in the next step; we only wanted the
67	  # packages.

72	  tags: [sudo]
73	  ansible.builtin.shell: |
74	    curl -fsSL https://get.docker.com -o /tmp/get-docker.sh
75	    sh /tmp/get-docker.sh
76	    rm /tmp/get-docker.sh
77	  args:
78	    creates: /usr/bin/docker
79

84	  become: true
85	  tags: [sudo]
86	  ansible.builtin.apt:
87	    name: docker-ce-rootless-extras
88	    state: present

92	  when: ansible_facts["os_family"] == "Debian"
93	  become: true

144	  ansible.builtin.debug:

149	      automatically for new zsh sessions; for existing shells, either

12	| "What does manager Y install?" | [§ Per-manager catalog](#per-manager-catalog) |
13	| "I'm adding a new tool — which manager should I use?" | [§ Decision tree](#decision-tree-for-new-tools) |
14	| "Why is X managed by Z and not W?" | [§ Multi-mechanism tools + rationale](#multi-mechanism-tools--rationale) |
15	| "How is X upgraded?" | [`upgrades.md`](upgrades.md) |
16	
17	> Convention reminder: install-only by design (see [`upgrades.md` § Why
18	> install and upgrade are split](upgrades.md#why-install-and-upgrade-are-split)).
19	> Every install path here uses `state: present` / `creates:` / `[[ -d … ]]`
20	> guards; nothing in `chezmoi apply` silently bumps a tool's version. The
21	> only thing that intentionally moves tools forward is
22	> `scripts/upgrade_tools.sh` (via `just upgrade-*`).

26	## TL;DR — manager landscape
27	
28	| Manager | Owns | Where listed | Upgrade category |
29	|---|---|---|---|
30	| **Bootstrap** (`run_once_before_*.sh.tmpl`) | Homebrew itself, uv, mise, ansible-core, apt prereqs | `run_once_before_00_bootstrap.sh.tmpl` | n/a (one-shot, idempotent) |
31	| **Homebrew formulae** | General macOS GUI helpers (`tailscale`, `mas`) + role-driven formulae (in `base`, `devtools`, `coding_agents`, …) | `dot_config/homebrew/Brewfile.tmpl` + scattered `community.general.homebrew:` tasks | `brew` |
32	| **Homebrew casks** | macOS GUI apps, gated by `installBrewApps`, `installAiDesktopApps`, or `installGamingApps` | `Brewfile.darwin.tmpl` | `brew` (`--cask --greedy`) |
33	| **Ansible roles** | The majority — 26 roles spanning shells, devtools, agents, language toolchains, networking, security | `dot_ansible/roles/*/tasks/main.yml` | indirect (each role calls one of: brew / apt / mise / uv / npm / cargo / gem / dotnet / curl-installer / github-release) |
34	| **mise** | Runtime versions: `node`, `bun`, `rust`, `go`, `dotnet`, `ruby` (oldEL: ruby only) | `dot_config/mise/config.toml.tmpl` | `mise` |
35	| **uv** | Python CLI tools (~13 entries in `python_uv_tools` + 1 in `llm_tools` + `litellm`) | `dot_ansible/roles/python_uv_tools/defaults/main.yml`, `dot_ansible/roles/llm_tools/defaults/main.yml`, ad-hoc `uv tool install` in `coding_agents` (specify-cli) + `security_tools` (pre-commit) | `uv` (`uv tool upgrade --all`) |
36	| **npm** (global) | JS CLIs (~5: copilot-cli, codex, gemini-cli, openchamber, bitwarden, readability-cli) + `tldr` + `tree-sitter-cli` | `js_cli_tools/defaults/main.yml`, scattered `community.general.npm:` + `mise exec -- npm install -g` | `npm` (`npm -g update`) |
37	| **cargo** | Rust crates: `recon`, `pueue` (Linux), `tree-sitter-cli` (fallback), `alacritty` (Linux build), `modelsdev` (Linux fallback) | `rust_cargo_tools/defaults/main.yml` (currently `[]`) + hard-coded in tasks | `cargo` (`cargo install-update -a`) |
38	| **dotnet** (global tools) | `azure-cost-cli` (binary `azure-cost`) | `dotnet_tools/defaults/main.yml` | `dotnet` |
39	| **gem** | `try-cli` (binary `try`), `tmuxinator` | `ruby_gem_tools/defaults/main.yml` | `gem` |
40	| **curl-installer** (vendor `install.sh`) | Self-managed coding agents + a handful of system tools: claude, opencode, cursor-agent, agy, rtk, ollama, atuin, docker, zoxide, direnv, just, llmfit, starship | `dot_ansible/roles/coding_agents/`, `llm_tools/`, `devtools/`, `starship/`, `atuin/`, `docker/`, bootstrap | `agents` (subset of these has a known self-update subcommand) |
41	| **GitHub-release downloads** | ~30 Linux user-level fallbacks for ripgrep/fd/jq/git-lfs/gh/glab/bat/eza/git-delta/diffnav/glow/gum/vhs/freeze/yazi/superfile/btop/zellij/sesh/worktrunk/workmux/tailspin/dasel/yq/jnv/doggo/gping/trippy/bandwhich/rustscan/cloudflared/ngrok/speedtest/gitleaks/lazygit/neovim + macOS fallbacks for specstory/codexbar | Each role's `_release_fallback` block | **none** (install-only — see [Coverage gaps](#coverage-gaps-install-only-no-automated-upgrade)) |
42	| **chezmoi externals** | git checkouts on weekly refresh: oh-my-zsh + plugins, oh-my-bash, ble.sh, TPM, fzf (Linux), toolkami.rb | `.chezmoiexternal.toml.tmpl` | `externals` (`chezmoi apply --refresh-externals`) |
43	| **apt** / **yum** | Distro packages (build deps, ffmpeg, audit, fontconfig, libnotify-bin, system git/zsh/bash, Steam launcher/runtime, …) | scattered `ansible.builtin.apt:` / `ansible.builtin.yum:` in roles | **none** (relies on `apt upgrade` outside this repo) |
44	| **flatpak** | Discord (default channel on Linux) | `gui_apps_linux/tasks/main.yml` | `flatpak` (`flatpak update -y`) |

47	
48	## Install order
49	
50	Five phases in chronological order. Anything earlier MUST be present
51	before the next phase can run.
52	
53	```
54	┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
55	│ Phase 0 — Bootstrap (run_once_before_*)                                 │
56	│   curl-installer: Homebrew, uv, mise                                    │
57	│   apt: build-essential, git, curl (Linux prereqs for Linuxbrew)         │
58	│   apt: libffi-dev, libyaml-dev, python3-dev (Linux non-noRoot only)     │
59	│   uv: ansible-core (pinned Python 3.13)                                 │
60	│   ansible-galaxy: community.general collection                          │
61	│   mise: install runtimes from ~/.config/mise/config.toml                │
62	└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
63	                                  │
64	                                  ▼
65	┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
66	│ Phase 1 — chezmoi apply (config file deploy)                            │
67	│   Deploys dot_* files; doesn't install tools directly                   │
68	└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
69	                                  │
70	                                  ▼
71	┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
72	│ Phase 2 — Ansible (run_onchange_after_20_ansible_roles)                 │
73	│   Runs all 26 roles; each dispatches to its underlying manager          │
74	│   (brew / apt / mise / uv / npm / cargo / gem / dotnet / curl / gh-rel) │
75	└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
76	                                  │
77	                                  ▼
78	┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
79	│ Phase 3 — Brew bundle (run_onchange_after_30_brew_bundle)               │
80	│   `brew bundle --no-upgrade` against ~/.config/homebrew/Brewfile*       │
81	│   Mostly GUI casks (macOS); skipped unless Brew/AI/gaming apps enabled  │
82	└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
83	                                  │
84	                                  ▼
85	┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
86	│ Phase 4 — Per-application onchange scripts                              │
87	│   Completion regen (run_after_50_generate_completions)                  │
88	│   bat theme cache (run_onchange_after_25_bat_theme)                     │
89	│   ble.sh compile (run_onchange_after_26_install_blesh)                  │
90	│   Global skills restore (run_onchange_after_40_install_global_skills)   │
91	└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
92	```
93	
94	The bootstrap is **single-source-of-truth** for the foundational tools
95	that everything else depends on. If you find yourself wanting to add
96	`mise` / `uv` / Homebrew elsewhere, the answer is almost always "extend
97	the bootstrap, then assume it in the role". The Linux noRoot path
98	(`profile=ubuntu_server` or RHEL/CentOS without sudo) skips the apt
99	prereqs and Linuxbrew, falling back to per-tool curl-installers and
100	GitHub releases — coverage is intentionally narrower (no GUI, no
101	system-wide installs).
102	
103	---
104	
105	## Per-manager catalog
106	
107	Each subsection below covers one manager. Format:
108	
109	- **Owns** — what tools end up under this manager's control
110	- **How a tool gets there** — the canonical "I want to add tool X via this manager" recipe
111	- **Per-OS notes** — branching when relevant
112	- **Upgrade path** — link to the matching category in `upgrades.md`
113	
114	The ansible roles section is split into thematic subsections because
115	26 roles in one table is unreadable.
116	
117	### 1. Bootstrap scripts (pre-chezmoi)
118	
119	**Files**: `run_once_before_00_bootstrap.sh.tmpl`,
120	`run_once_before_02_fix_intel_homebrew.sh.tmpl`,
121	`run_once_before_50_opencode_migrate.sh.tmpl`
122	
123	**Owns** — the four foundational managers that everything else
124	assumes:
125	
126	| Tool | Mechanism | Per-OS |
127	|---|---|---|
128	| **Homebrew** | `Homebrew/install` curl script | macOS always; Linux only when `installBrewApps=true` & non-noRoot & arch∈{amd64,arm64}. Mirrors via `HOMEBREW_BREW_GIT_REMOTE` + bottle/API domains (**BFSU** baseline; `brew-mirror` switches to USTC/Aliyun/TUNA) when `useChineseMirror=true`. Aliyun's `brew.git` is broken (hangs) and `HOMEBREW_CORE_GIT_REMOTE` stays unset (API mode) — see [mirrors.md](../tools/mirrors.md#brew-update--any-brew-command-hangs-for-60s-then-does-nothing) |
129	| **uv** | `curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh \| sh` | all OSes if missing |
130	| **mise** | `curl https://mise.run \| sh`, with direct `mise.jdx.dev/mise-latest-linux-${arch}[-musl]` fallback (musl forced when glibc < 2.28) | all OSes; arch detection (x64/arm64/armv7) |
131	| **ansible-core** | `uv tool install --force --python 3.13 ansible-core` | all OSes; force-refreshes if existing ansible runs on Python < 3.10 |
132	| **ansible-galaxy: community.general** | `ansible-galaxy collection install --force-with-deps` | all OSes |
133	| **mise runtimes** | `mise install --yes` (consumes `~/.config/mise/config.toml`) | all OSes — see [§ mise](#4-mise-runtime-versions) |
134	
135	**Linux prereqs (apt)** to make Linuxbrew + mise Ruby + ansible-cryptography
136	buildable: `build-essential`, `procps`, `curl`, `file`, `git` (always);
137	`libffi-dev`, `libyaml-dev`, `python3-dev` (non-noRoot only).
138	
139	**Intel-Mac-only side script**: `run_once_before_02_fix_intel_homebrew.sh.tmpl`
140	runs `softwareupdate -i` for Xcode CLT, then `brew cleanup` +
141	`brew link --overwrite git`.
142	
143	**One-shot migrations**: `run_once_before_50_opencode_migrate.sh.tmpl`
144	moves a legacy config file (`~/.config/opencode/config.json` →
145	`opencode.json`). Not an install.
146	
147	**Adding to bootstrap**: only when the new tool is required *before*
148	ansible runs — e.g. ansible itself, mise (because ansible roles call
149	`mise exec`), uv (because some roles call `uv tool install`). Otherwise
150	prefer an ansible role.
151	
152	### 2. Homebrew (formulae + casks)
153	
154	Three Brewfile templates + scattered `community.general.homebrew[_cask]`
155	tasks in ansible roles. The split is **macOS-centric**: Linux Brewfile is
156	empty, Linuxbrew use happens role-by-role.
157	
158	#### 2.1 Brewfiles
159	
160	| File | Owns |
161	|---|---|
162	| `Brewfile.tmpl` (shared) | General macOS GUI support when `installBrewApps=true`: tap `nikitabobko/tap`, formulae `mas`, `tailscale` |
163	| `Brewfile.darwin.tmpl` | All GUI casks — see table below |
164	| `Brewfile.linux.tmpl` | Empty (commented-out placeholders only) |
165	
166	**macOS casks** (~25 active, gated by feature flags):
167	
168	| Cask | Gating |
169	|---|---|
170	| `alacritty`, `warp`, `cmux`, `cursor`, `visual-studio-code` | `installBrewApps` |
171	| `claude`, `opencode-desktop`, `antigravity` | `installAiDesktopApps` |
172	| `chatgpt`, `codex-app` | `installAiDesktopApps` + arm64 |
173	| `codeisland` (tap `wxtsky/tap`) | `installAiDesktopApps` |
174	| `ollama-app` | `installAiDesktopApps` + `installLlmTools` |
175	| `steam` | `installGamingApps` |
176	| `nikitabobko/tap/aerospace`, `alt-tab`, `raycast`, `maccy`, `scroll-reverser`, `the-unarchiver`, `applite` | `installBrewApps` |
177	| `discord` | `installBrewApps` |
178	| `arc` | `installBrewApps` |
179	| `obsidian`, `google-drive`, `grammarly-desktop`, `super-productivity` | `installBrewApps` |
180	| `spotify`, `anki` | `installBrewApps` |
181	| `tailscale-app` | `installBrewApps` |
182	| `dbeaver-community` | `installBrewApps` |
183	| `superset` | `installBrewApps` + arm64 |
184	
185	Many more entries exist in commented-out form (minecraft, telegram,
186	openvpn-connect, etc.) — uncomment to enable.
187	
188	#### 2.2 Role-driven brew (formulae + casks)
189	
190	Most CLI formulae land via ansible roles, not the Brewfile. Examples:
191	
192	- `base/tasks/main.yml`: `git`, `git-lfs`, `curl`, `wget`, `ripgrep`, `fd`, `jq`, `tree`, `just`
193	- `devtools/tasks/main.yml`: large set — `bat`, `gh`, `glab`, `diffnav`, `git-delta`, `eza`, `tlrc`, `glow`, `gum`, `vhs`, `freeze`, `thefuck`, `zoxide`, `direnv`, `yazi`, `superfile`, `tmux`, `sesh`, `worktrunk`, `workmux`, `zellij`, `btop`, `htop`, `duckdb`, `rclone`, `coreutils`, `taplo`, `television`, `pandoc`, `tailspin`, `lnav`, `grc`, `dasel`, `yq`, `jnv`, `witr`, `figlet`, `toilet`, `lolcat`, `fastfetch`, `shellcheck`, `shfmt`, `bats-core`, `git-graph`
194	- `coding_agents/tasks/main.yml`: `claude-code` (cask), `codex` (cask), `gemini-cli` (formula), `rtk` (formula), `specstory`, `codexbar`, `td`, `sidecar` (all with tap setup)
195	- `networking_tools/`: `nmap`, `arp-scan`, `mtr`, `iperf3`, `doggo`, `httpie`, `gping`, `trippy`, `bandwhich`, `rustscan`, `speedtest` (tap `teamookla/speedtest`), `ngrok`, `cloudflared`
196	- `media_tools/`: `ffmpeg`, `imagemagick`, `exiftool`, `vips`
197	- `iac_tools/`: `azure-cli`, `hashicorp/tap/terraform`, `opentofu`
198	- `llm_tools/`: `llmfit`, `models`, `ollama`
199	- `security_tools/`: `gitleaks`
200	- `starship/`, `atuin/`, `neovim/`, `bash/` (gawk), `zsh/` — each installs its primary tool via homebrew formula on macOS
201	- `pueue` (from `rust_cargo_tools/`): macOS uses homebrew formula
202	
203	**Per-OS dispatch** is the universal pattern in roles: macOS branch uses
204	`community.general.homebrew` / `homebrew_cask`; Linux branches use apt,
205	Linuxbrew (when present), or GitHub releases. See each role for the
206	explicit `when: ansible_facts["os_family"] == "Darwin"` guard.
207	
208	**Tap inventory** (added by various roles): `nikitabobko/tap`,
209	`wxtsky/tap` (CodeIsland), `hashicorp/tap` (terraform),
210	`teamookla/speedtest`, `specstoryai/tap`, `steipete/tap` (CodexBar),
211	`marcus/tap` (td, sidecar), `dlvhdr/formulae`, `raine/workmux`.
212	
213	Homebrew 6+ refuses formulae/casks from untrusted third-party taps. Role-driven
214	taps must run a `brew tap-info <tap>` → `brew trust <tap>` check before installing
215	from that tap; Brewfile taps are handled by the brew-bundle run-script before it
216	calls `brew bundle`. See
217	[`pitfalls/homebrew-6-refuses-untrusted-tap-formula.md`](../../pitfalls/homebrew-6-refuses-untrusted-tap-formula.md).
218	
219	**Adding via homebrew**: prefer a brew formula/cask only when the tool
220	is macOS-shipped and Linux equivalents go via apt or release tarball.
221	Linux-first tools rarely belong in the Brewfile.
222	
223	#### 2.3 Homebrew prefix dispatch helper
224	
225	`scripts/upgrade_tools.sh::_uv_install_style` (and mirrored helpers in
226	`python_uv_tools/tasks/main.yml`) inspect whether a binary lives under
227	`brew --prefix` to decide between `brew upgrade <pkg>` and the tool's
228	native self-update. This avoids the "I `uv self update` on a brew-uv
229	host and silently no-op" trap — see
230	[`pitfalls/uv-self-update-homebrew-noop.md`](https://github.com/daviddwlee84/dotfiles/blob/main/pitfalls/uv-self-update-homebrew-noop.md).
231	
232	### 3. Ansible roles
233	
234	26 roles under `dot_ansible/roles/`. Triggered by
235	`.chezmoiscripts/global/run_onchange_after_20_ansible_roles.sh.tmpl`
236	(re-runs when any role's `tasks/main.yml` or `defaults/main.yml` changes
237	— SHA256-tracked).
238	
239	**Universal patterns**:
240	
241	- `state: present` / `creates:` — install-only, no silent upgrades
242	- Per-OS branching via `when: ansible_facts["os_family"] == "Darwin"` (or `["Debian", "RedHat"]`)
243	- `tags: [sudo]` on any `become: true` task (so noRoot mode skips them — see [`pitfalls/ansible-missing-sudo-tag.md`](https://github.com/daviddwlee84/dotfiles/blob/main/pitfalls/ansible-missing-sudo-tag.md))
244	- `failed_when: false` + `register:` for "is the tool installed?" probes
245	- Linux user-level fallback to `~/.local/bin` when distro package is missing or too old (handles RHEL/CentOS + noRoot + Apple-Silicon-not-bottled scenarios)
246	
247	**Role feature flags** (set in `.chezmoi.toml.tmpl` via prompts):
248	`installBrewApps`, `installAiDesktopApps`, `installCodingAgents`,
249	`installLlmTools`, `installPythonUvTools`, `installJsCliTools`,
250	`installDotnetTools`, `installIacTools`, `installMediaTools`,
251	`installNetworkingTools`, `installTunnelTools`, `installBitwarden`,
252	`installGamingApps`, `installInputMethod`, `installAuditd`. Roles gate themselves on the
253	matching flag; the bundle script `scripts/init/dotfiles_init.py` defines
254	profile presets (`minimal`, `cloud-vm` planned, default-developer, …).
255	
256	#### 3.1 Base / shared CLI
257	
258	| Role | Owns | Per-OS mechanism |
259	|---|---|---|
260	| `base` | `git`, `git-lfs`, `curl`, `wget`, `ripgrep`, `fd`, `jq`, `tree`, `just`, `gcc`/`build-essential`/`make` | macOS: brew formulae · Debian: apt (`fd-find` + `/usr/bin/fd` symlink) · RedHat: yum · `just` always via `curl https://just.systems/install.sh` · Linux user-level GitHub-release fallback to `~/.local/bin` for ripgrep/fd/jq/git-lfs |
261	| `homebrew` | (no installs — refresh + cleanup only, 24h-throttled) | n/a |
262	| `atuin` | `atuin` shell history sync | macOS: brew formula · Linux: `curl https://setup.atuin.sh \| sh -s -- --non-interactive` → `~/.atuin/bin/` |
263	| `nerdfonts` | `font-hack-nerd-font` | macOS: brew cask · Linux: download `Hack.zip` from `nerd-fonts/releases/latest` → `~/.local/share/fonts` + `fc-cache -fv` |
264	
265	#### 3.2 Shells (`bash`, `zsh`, `starship`)
266	
267	| Role | Owns | Per-OS mechanism |
268	|---|---|---|
269	| `bash` | `gawk` (ble.sh dep, unconditional); homebrew `bash` 5.x + `/etc/shells` + `chsh` (macOS only when `primary_shell="bash"`) | macOS: brew · Debian: apt · RedHat: yum |
270	| `zsh` | system `zsh` package; **source-build zsh 5.9** to `~/.local` on RHEL/CentOS 7 if system zsh < 5.3; `chsh` when `primary_shell="zsh"` (default) | macOS: brew · Debian: apt · RedHat: yum + ncurses-devel source build fallback. oh-my-zsh + plugins ship as externals (§12) |
271	| `starship` | `starship` prompt | macOS: brew formula · Linux: `curl https://starship.rs/install.sh \| sh -s -- --yes` → sudo `/usr/local/bin` → user `~/.local/bin` fallback |
272	
273	The `primaryShell` chezmoi prompt gates the `chsh` call only — both
274	shells deploy their configs everywhere. See AGENTS.md → "`primaryShell`
275	choice gates `chsh` only" hard invariant.
276	
277	#### 3.3 DevTools (mega-role)
278	
279	Single role, ~50 tools — the kitchen sink for terminal-life CLIs.
280	There's a backlog item ([`backlog/devtools-role-split.md`](https://github.com/daviddwlee84/dotfiles/blob/main/backlog/devtools-role-split.md))
281	considering whether to break this up.
282	
283	**macOS** (homebrew, taps: `dlvhdr/formulae` for `gh-dash`,
284	`raine/workmux`): `bat`, `bats-core`, `gh`, `glab`, `diffnav`, `git-delta`,
285	`git-graph`, `eza`, `tlrc`, `glow`, `gum`, `vhs`, `freeze`, `thefuck`,
286	`zoxide`, `direnv`, `yazi`, `superfile`, `tmux`, `sesh`, `worktrunk`,
287	`workmux`, `zellij`, `btop`, `htop`, `duckdb`, `rclone`, `coreutils`,
288	`taplo`, `television`, `pandoc`, `tailspin`, `lnav`, `grc`, `dasel`,
289	`yq`, `jnv`, `witr`, `figlet`, `toilet`, `lolcat`, `fastfetch`,
290	`shellcheck`, `shfmt`.
291	
292	**Linux** — per-tool dispatch. The pattern is **apt/yum (system) →
293	GitHub release tarball or installer (user)**:
294	
295	| Tool | Linux mechanism (preferred → fallback) |
296	|---|---|
297	| `gh` | GitHub `.deb` → user tarball |
298	| `glab` | GitHub `.deb` → user tarball |
299	| `bat` | apt + `/usr/bin/bat` symlink → GitHub musl release |
300	| `bats` | apt → GitHub release `install.sh` |
301	| `zoxide` | `curl install.sh` |
302	| `eza` | gierens.de apt repo → user GitHub musl → brew aarch64 |
303	| `git-delta` | `.deb` (x86_64) → brew aarch64 → user GitHub musl |
304	| `diffnav` | user GitHub release |
305	| `gh-dash` | `gh extension install dlvhdr/gh-dash` |
306	| `gh-notify` | `gh extension install meiji163/gh-notify` |
307	| `git-graph` | user GitHub release (x86_64 only) |
308	| `tldr` | system npm or `mise exec -- npm install -g tldr` |
309	| `glow`, `gum`, `vhs`, `freeze`, `duckdb` | user GitHub release tarballs |
310	| `rclone` | official installer or GitHub release |
311	| `thefuck` | `uv tool install thefuck` (Python 3.11, distutils workaround) |
312	| `shellcheck`, `shfmt` | apt or release |
313	| `direnv` | apt or installer |
314	| `yazi`, `superfile`, `btop`, `zellij`, `sesh`, `worktrunk`, `workmux` | Linuxbrew or GitHub release |
315	| `tmux` | apt → `nelsonenzo/tmux-appimage` AppImage to `~/.local/share/tmux-appimage/` when system version < 3.3 (required by `display-menu` popup) — see AGENTS.md "Tmux popup menu ≥ 3.3 required" |
316	| `htop`, `pandoc` | apt |
317	| `taplo`, `television (tv)`, `lnav`, `grc`, `tailspin (tspin)`, `dasel`, `yq`, `jnv`, `witr` | mix of apt + release |
318	| `ccze` | apt only (Linux-only tool, no macOS equivalent) |
319	
320	#### 3.4 Coding agents
321	
322	Role: `dot_ansible/roles/coding_agents/tasks/main.yml`. Gated on
323	`installCodingAgents`. **The most heterogeneous role** — every agent
324	ships via a different mechanism upstream, and the role mirrors that.
325	
326	| Agent | macOS | Linux | Notes / source lines |
327	|---|---|---|---|
328	| `terminal-notifier` / `libnotify-bin` | brew formula / apt (Debian) | apt (Debian only) | notifier helpers, lines 9–29 |

403	### 4. mise (runtime versions)
404	
405	**Config**: `dot_config/mise/config.toml.tmpl`
406	
407	`[settings]`: `ruby.compile = false`.
408	
409	**Modern hosts** (default):
410	
411	| Runtime | Version | Gated on |
412	|---|---|---|
413	| `node` | `lts` | always |
414	| `bun` | `1` | `installExtraRuntimes` |
415	| `rust` | `stable` | `installExtraRuntimes` |
416	| `go` | `latest` | `installExtraRuntimes` |
417	| `dotnet` | `10` | `installDotnetTools` |
418	| `ruby` | `3` | `installExtraRuntimes` (+ not `noRoot`) |
419	
420	**Version-pinning rationale**: `node=lts` / `rust=stable` / `go=latest` use
421	moving channels because each promises backward compatibility (Go's
422	[go1compat](https://go.dev/doc/go1compat) makes `latest` as safe as
423	rust's `stable`). `bun=1` and `dotnet=10` pin the **major** instead —
424	neither guarantees no-break across majors (bun ships behavior changes on
425	minors; .NET majors bump TFMs / SDK behavior), and `dotnet=10` is also the
426	current LTS (8/9 are at/near EOL by mid-2026). Bump `dotnet` deliberately
427	when the next LTS (12) lands. `ruby=3` tracks the 3.x line.
428	
429	`go` replaces the old macOS-only brew install from the `security_tools`
430	role, so Linux hosts now get a managed Go too (previously a gap).
431	
432	Ruby is **skipped in noRoot mode** (`profile=ubuntu_server` without
433	sudo) because it needs `libffi-dev` / `libyaml-dev` to build, which
434	require apt.
435	
436	**oldEL (CentOS/RHEL 7, glibc 2.17)**: only `ruby = "3"` — other
437	runtimes have glibc/libstdc++ requirements too new for EL7.
438	
439	**Upgrade**: `just upgrade-mise` → `mise self-update --yes` + `mise upgrade`
440	(honours the version constraints in the config; `lts`/`latest` move
441	forward, pinned versions don't).
442	
443	**Adding a runtime**: edit `dot_config/mise/config.toml.tmpl` directly.
444	Runtime-version gating across hosts is on the [backlog](https://github.com/daviddwlee84/dotfiles/blob/main/backlog/mise-runtime-gating.md).
445	
446	**Why mise (not nvm/rbenv/pyenv/asdf/n)**: unified, language-agnostic,
447	respects `.tool-versions`, doesn't fight shell init order. Python is
448	deliberately **not** mise-managed — that's uv's territory (faster + no
449	build-from-source for CPython, which the noRoot Linux path can't do).
450	The [backlog](https://github.com/daviddwlee84/dotfiles/blob/main/backlog/mise-runtime-gating.md) tracks
451	finer-grained per-host gating.
452

506	### 6. npm (global Node CLIs)
507	
508	**Config**: `dot_ansible/roles/js_cli_tools/defaults/main.yml` for the
509	JS-tools-specific list. Scattered global-npm installs live in other
510	roles (`coding_agents`, `bitwarden`, `lazyvim_deps`, `devtools`).
511	
512	**Install dispatch** (universal pattern across roles):
513	
514	```yaml
515	# On Linux:
516	mise exec -- npm install -g <package>
517	# Falls back to system npm if mise has no node registered
518	# On macOS:
519	community.general.npm: { name: <package>, global: true }
520	```
521	
522	Linux explicitly uses `mise exec -- npm` to avoid the Ubuntu apt npm
523	(too old; system Node 12 fails `engine` checks for modern packages and
524	`/usr/local/lib/node_modules` is root-owned, breaking `--global` for
525	non-root users). See [`pitfalls/ansible-js-cli-tools-old-system-node.md`](https://github.com/daviddwlee84/dotfiles/blob/main/pitfalls/ansible-js-cli-tools-old-system-node.md).
526	
527	**Inventory**:
528	
529	| Package | Binary | Role / line |
530	|---|---|---|
531	| `readability-cli` | `readable` | `js_cli_tools/defaults/main.yml` |
532	| `@bitwarden/cli` | `bw` | `bitwarden/tasks/main.yml` |
533	| `@githubnext/github-copilot-cli` | `github-copilot-cli` | `coding_agents/tasks/main.yml:134-168` |
534	| `@openai/codex` | `codex` (Linux only — macOS uses brew cask) | `coding_agents/tasks/main.yml:172-236` |
535	| `@google/gemini-cli` | `gemini` (Linux always; macOS fallback if brew formula fails) | `coding_agents/tasks/main.yml:240-300` |
536	| `@openchamber/web` | `openchamber` | `coding_agents/tasks/main.yml:1188-1222` |
537	| `tldr` | `tldr` (Linux only — macOS uses `tlrc` via brew) | `devtools/tasks/main.yml` |
538	| `tree-sitter-cli` | `tree-sitter` | `lazyvim_deps/tasks/main.yml` (preferred over cargo fallback) |
539	
540	**Upgrade**: `just upgrade-npm` → `npm -g update` with `mise exec --`
541	fallback.
542	
543	**Adding an npm tool**: append to `js_cli_tools/defaults/main.yml` (for
544	general utilities); for an agent CLI, add the install task to
545	`coding_agents/tasks/main.yml` matching the existing dispatch pattern
546	(macOS via system npm, Linux via `mise exec -- npm install -g`).

553	**Rust install**: `mise install rust@latest` (preferred), with two
554	fallback layers on noRoot/oldEL boxes: direct `rustup-init`, then
555	`https://static.rust-lang.org` when the configured mirror's manifest

560	| Crate | Mechanism | Notes |
561	|---|---|---|
562	| `recon` | `cargo install --git https://github.com/gavraz/recon --locked` | git source (no crates.io publish yet) |
563	| `pueue` | macOS brew formula; Linux `cargo install pueue --locked` | + `pueued.service` systemd user unit; version check `pueue_min_version=4.0.0` (warn-only) |

621	### 10. curl-installer (self-managed CLIs)
622	
623	Tools that ship via vendor `install.sh` instead of any package manager.
624	Mostly the AI coding agents (each vendor maintains their own installer
625	+ self-update subcommand). All landing paths are user-writable so
626	in-binary self-update works without sudo.
627	
628	**Inventory**:
629	
630	| Tool | Install URL | Lands at | Source role |
631	|---|---|---|---|
632	| Homebrew | `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Homebrew/install/HEAD/install.sh` | `/usr/local/bin/brew` (macOS) / `/home/linuxbrew/.linuxbrew/` (Linux) | bootstrap |
633	| uv | `https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh` | `~/.local/bin/uv` (or `~/.cargo/bin/uv`) | bootstrap |
634	| mise | `https://mise.run` | `~/.local/bin/mise` | bootstrap |
635	| just | `https://just.systems/install.sh` | `/usr/local/bin/just` or `~/.local/bin/just` | `base` |
636	| starship | `https://starship.rs/install.sh` | `/usr/local/bin/starship` or `~/.local/bin/starship` | `starship` |
637	| atuin | `https://setup.atuin.sh` | `~/.atuin/bin/atuin` | `atuin` |
638	| docker | `https://get.docker.com` | system docker (rootless variant) | `docker` (Linux) |
639	| zoxide | (vendor installer) | `~/.local/bin/zoxide` | `devtools` (Linux fallback) |
640	| direnv | (vendor installer) | `~/.local/bin/direnv` | `devtools` (Linux fallback) |
641	| **Claude Code** | `https://claude.ai/install.sh` | `~/.claude/local/bin/claude` | `coding_agents` (Linux) |
642	| **OpenCode** | `https://opencode.ai/install` (+ `--no-modify-path`) | `~/.opencode/bin/opencode` | `coding_agents` (macOS + Linux) |
643	| **Cursor CLI** | `https://cursor.com/install` | `~/.local/bin/cursor-agent` | `coding_agents` |
644	| **Antigravity CLI** | `https://antigravity.google/cli/install.sh` (patched `--skip-path --skip-aliases`) | `~/.local/bin/agy` + `agyc` symlink | `coding_agents` |
645	| **RTK** | `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rtk-ai/rtk/master/install.sh` | `~/.local/bin/rtk` | `coding_agents` (Linux) |
646	| **llmfit** | `https://llmfit.axjns.dev/install.sh` | `~/.local/bin/llmfit` (or system) | `llm_tools` (Linux) |
647	| **Ollama** | `https://ollama.com/install.sh` | system path (Linux, sudo) | `llm_tools` (Linux) |
648	| Ookla speedtest | `https://install.speedtest.net/app/cli/install.<distro>.sh` | system | `networking_tools` (Linux) |
649	
650	**Why curl-installer over a package manager**:
651	
652	- Fast-moving releases — vendor controls cadence (Claude, OpenCode,
653	  Cursor, Antigravity push daily/weekly)
654	- Self-update subcommand exists and the installer is the canonical
655	  reinstall path → `cat_agents` in `scripts/upgrade_tools.sh` can call
656	  either
657	- Avoids the "brew formula is 3 weeks stale" problem (see commit
658	  history for the OpenCode move from `anomalyco/tap` to official
659	  installer)
660	- No tap/PPA/repo to maintain
661	
662	**Adding a curl-installer tool**:
663	
664	1. Pick a role (or add to `coding_agents` if it's an agent)
665	2. Use the canonical pattern: `which` check → `creates:` guard on the
666	   binary path → `curl ... | bash [-s -- --no-modify-path]` shell task
667	3. If the installer mutates shell rc files, add a `--no-modify-path`
668	   flag (or equivalent — see OpenCode and Antigravity blocks). The
669	   chezmoi-managed PATH is the SSOT
670	4. Update `scripts/upgrade_tools.sh::cat_agents` if the tool has a
671	   self-update subcommand (or just an installer-as-upgrader path)
672	5. If the binary lands somewhere other than `~/.local/bin` (e.g.
673	   `~/.opencode/bin/opencode`), add an existence-gated PATH prepend
674	   to `dot_config/shell/00_exports.sh.tmpl`
675	
676	### 11. GitHub-release downloads (user-level fallback)
677	
678	When apt/yum can't satisfy a version requirement (e.g. Apple Silicon
679	brew bottle missing, RHEL/CentOS package too old, noRoot host with no
680	sudo), roles fall back to downloading the latest GitHub release tarball
681	and extracting to `~/.local/bin` (user-writable, already on PATH).
682	
683	**Canonical pattern**:
684	
685	```yaml
686	- name: Get latest <tool> release
687	  ansible.builtin.uri:
688	    url: https://api.github.com/repos/<owner>/<repo>/releases/latest
689	    return_content: true
690	  register: <tool>_release
691	
692	- name: Compute <tool> arch
693	  ansible.builtin.set_fact:
694	    <tool>_arch: "{{ 'amd64' if target_architecture in ['x86_64', 'amd64'] else 'arm64' if ... else 'unsupported' }}"
695	
696	- name: Download / extract / copy into ~/.local/bin
697	  block:
698	    - get_url: { url: "https://github.com/.../{{ tag }}/{{ asset }}", dest: /tmp/..., retries: 3, delay: 5, timeout: 120 }
699	    - unarchive: { src: ..., dest: /tmp/..., remote_src: true }
700	    - find:      { paths: /tmp/..., patterns: <binary>, file_type: file }
701	    - copy:      { src: ..., dest: "{{ ansible_facts['env']['HOME'] }}/.local/bin/<binary>", mode: '0755' }
702	  rescue:
703	    - debug: "<tool> installation failed (likely network timeout) - skipping"
704	```
705	
706	**Tools using this pattern** (rough list — see each role's `tasks/main.yml`):
707	
708	- `base`: `ripgrep`, `fd`, `jq`, `git-lfs`
709	- `devtools`: `gh`, `glab`, `bat`, `bats`, `eza`, `git-delta`, `diffnav`, `git-graph`, `glow`, `gum`, `vhs`, `freeze`, `duckdb`, `yazi`, `superfile`, `btop`, `zellij`, `sesh`, `worktrunk`, `workmux`, `taplo`, `tv` (television), `lnav`, `tailspin`, `dasel`, `yq`, `jnv`, `witr`
710	- `networking_tools`: `doggo`, `gping`, `trippy`, `bandwhich`, `rustscan`, `cloudflared`
711	- `neovim`: nvim tarball
712	- `lazyvim_deps`: `lazygit` fallback
713	- `coding_agents`: `specstory`, `codexbar`, `td`, `sidecar`, `agy` (all also have brew formula / cask as primary)
714	- `security_tools`: `gitleaks`
715	- `iac_tools`: `terraform`, `opentofu` user fallback (zip from `releases.hashicorp.com` / GitHub)
716	- `gui_apps_linux`: `AppImageLauncher Lite`, Zen Browser AppImage
717	- `bitwarden`: Desktop `.deb` fallback (Linux)
718	
719	**⚠️ Coverage gap**: GitHub-release downloads use a `creates:` guard
720	on the binary path, so once installed they're **never refreshed by
721	`chezmoi apply`** — and `scripts/upgrade_tools.sh` has no category for
722	them. The only way to refresh: `rm` the binary, re-apply. See
723	[§ Coverage gaps](#coverage-gaps-install-only-no-automated-upgrade)
724	below.
725	
726	**Adding a GitHub-release tool**: copy the canonical block from
727	e.g. `devtools/tasks/main.yml` (look for an existing tool with a
728	similar arch matrix), substitute owner/repo/asset-name. Always wrap in
729	`block:` / `rescue:` (vendor-side outages happen) and use
730	`retries: 3, delay: 5, timeout: 120` on the download.
731	
732	### 12. chezmoi externals (refresh-periodic git/file fetches)
733	
734	**Config**: `.chezmoiexternal.toml.tmpl`
735	
736	`chezmoi apply` fetches these on a schedule. All set
737	`refreshPeriod = "168h"` (weekly), `--depth 1` clones, `--ff-only`
738	pulls.
739	
740	| Path | Type | Source | Gating |
741	|---|---|---|---|
742	| `.oh-my-zsh` | git-repo | `ohmyzsh/ohmyzsh.git` | always |
743	| `.oh-my-zsh/custom/plugins/zsh-autosuggestions` | git-repo | `zsh-users/zsh-autosuggestions.git` | always |
744	| `.oh-my-zsh/custom/plugins/zsh-syntax-highlighting` | git-repo | `zsh-users/zsh-syntax-highlighting.git` | always |
745	| `.oh-my-zsh/custom/plugins/zsh-completions` | git-repo | `zsh-users/zsh-completions.git` | always |
746	| `.oh-my-zsh/custom/plugins/zsh-vi-mode` | git-repo | `jeffreytse/zsh-vi-mode.git` | `enableVimMode` |
747	| `.oh-my-bash` | git-repo | `ohmybash/oh-my-bash.git` | always |
748	| `.local/src/blesh` | git-repo (`--recurse-submodules`) | `akinomyoga/ble.sh.git` | always; compiled by `run_onchange_after_26_install_blesh.sh.tmpl` → `~/.local/share/blesh/ble.sh` |
749	| `.tmux/plugins/tpm` | git-repo | `tmux-plugins/tpm.git` | always |
750	| `.fzf` | git-repo | `junegunn/fzf.git` | Linux only (ansible runs `~/.fzf/install --bin`) |
751	| `.local/share/toolkami/toolkami.rb` | file (executable) | `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aperoc/toolkami/refs/heads/main/toolkami.rb` | always |
752	
753	**Why externals (not git clone in a role)**:
754	
755	- Refresh cadence is built-in (chezmoi handles `git pull` on schedule;
756	  ansible roles don't have a "re-pull every N hours" primitive)
757	- One place to see "what third-party source code lives on this machine"
758	- `chezmoi update --refresh-externals` is the explicit forced refresh
759	
760	**Upgrade**: `just upgrade-externals` → `chezmoi apply --refresh-externals`.
761	
762	**Adding an external**: prepend an entry to `.chezmoiexternal.toml.tmpl`.
763	If the cloned repo needs a post-clone compile step (like ble.sh),
764	attach a `run_onchange_after_NN_*.sh.tmpl` script that re-runs when
765	the external's commit changes.
766	
767	**Past pitfalls**:
768	
769	- ble.sh local-changes-overwritten ([`pitfalls/chezmoi-update-blesh-local-changes-overwritten.md`](https://github.com/daviddwlee84/dotfiles/blob/main/pitfalls/chezmoi-update-blesh-local-changes-overwritten.md)) — source clone moved out of the chezmoi external path to decouple from `make install`
770

772	
773	**The pragmatic Linux backbone**. Roles use apt/yum for tools that
774	are well-packaged by the distro (i.e. recent enough, available, no
775	notable upstream-vs-downstream skew).

777	**Used by these roles** (non-exhaustive):

779	| Role | apt packages | yum packages |
780	|---|---|---|
781	| `base` | `git`, `git-lfs`, `curl`, `wget`, `ripgrep`, `fd-find`, `jq`, `tree`, `build-essential` | `git`, `git-lfs`, `curl`, `wget`, `jq`, `tree`, `gcc`, `gcc-c++`, `make` |
782	| `bash` | (uses brew on Linux only when primary_shell=bash) | — |
783	| `zsh` | `zsh` | `zsh` (or ncurses-devel + source build on RHEL 7) |
784	| `devtools` | `bat`, `gh`, `glab`, `eza`, `git-delta`, `htop`, `pandoc`, `tldr`, etc. (many) | similar subset |
785	| `media_tools` | `ffmpeg`, `imagemagick`, `libimage-exiftool-perl`, `libvips-tools` | — |
786	| `networking_tools` | `nmap`, `arp-scan`, `mtr`, `iperf3`, `httpie`, `tcpdump` | same (minus `httpie`) |
787	| `coding_agents` | `libnotify-bin` (Debian only) | — |
788	| `lazyvim_deps` | (mostly via mise + GitHub releases) | — |
789	| `auditd` | `auditd`, `audispd-plugins` | `audit` |
790	| `gui_apps_linux` | `cmake`, `pkg-config`, font libs (Alacritty build), `libfuse2`, `copyq`, `playerctl`, `wmctrl`, `xdotool` | — |

792	| `iac_tools` | `azure-cli`, `terraform`, `opentofu` (via vendor apt repos) | — |

794	| `python_uv_tools` | `libffi-dev`, `libyaml-dev`, `python3-dev` (Ruby+ansible-cryptography compile deps) | `libffi-devel`, `libyaml-devel`, `python3-devel` |
795	
796	**Vendor apt repos managed** (require GPG key + sources.list.d entries):
797	
798	| Repo | What |
799	|---|---|
800	| `apt.releases.hashicorp.com` | terraform |
801	| `packages.microsoft.com` | azure-cli, vscode |
802	| `cli.github.com/packages` | gh |
803	| `gitlab.com/api/v4/projects/.../packages/debian` | glab |
804	| `pkgs.gierens.de` | eza |
805	| `ngrok-agent.s3.amazonaws.com` | ngrok |
806	| `apt.releases.opentofu.org` | opentofu (Cloudsmith) |

808	| PPA `ppa:appimagelauncher-team/stable` | AppImageLauncher |
809	
810	**Upgrade**: NOT covered by `scripts/upgrade_tools.sh`. Relies on
811	`sudo apt upgrade` / `sudo yum update` outside the repo's flow. This is
812	an intentional gap — distro upgrades are a sysadmin decision, not a
813	dotfiles decision.
814	
815	**Adding an apt/yum package**: in the relevant role's `tasks/main.yml`,
816	add an `ansible.builtin.apt` / `ansible.builtin.yum` task gated on
817	`os_family`. Always `become: true` + `tags: [sudo]` (so noRoot mode
818	skips it gracefully) and consider adding a user-level fallback for the
819	noRoot path if the tool is broadly useful.
